input.rationale: A full read of the Agreement (single Preamble section, paragraphs p0000–p0074) and a document-wide search for "insurance" return no insurance covenant anywhere, including in the General Provisions in Section 14. Kubient is a hosting/services vendor that under paragraph 9(b)(iii) undertakes the "collection, maintenance, management and storage of visitor information (data)" through the Auction Platform, so the rule expects insurance and the absence is a deviation from even the fallback position (E&O USD 1M; cyber USD 2M). We insert the shortest clause carrying only the two fallback elements as a new general provision 14(j); we have not volunteered the preferred CGL, workers' compensation or certificate terms given the low severity of this rule.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant (E&O USD 1M; cyber USD 2M) as a new general provision.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance covenant even though Kubient collects and stores visitor data through the Auction Platform, so we have added our fallback insurance position: errors and omissions cover of USD 1,000,000 and cyber liability cover of USD 2,000,000.

ops.text: Kubient shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
